ENDORSED BYAlan ColombieHarwinton RTC Chairman"I’m proud to endorse Peter Lumaj for Secretary of the State of Connecticut. Peter understands that election integrity is not partisan, it’s about trust between the government and the people. Having fled to America from a communist regime, where elections were meaningless, he knows firsthand why secure, transparent, and accountable elections matter. He will ensure every lawful vote counts while strengthening safeguards to restore public confidence in our system. Peter represents principled leadership that protects the process, not a political party, and I encourage Republicans, independents, and all voters who care about election integrity to support him this fall."View all endorsements →
